title: An etale equivalence relation on an affine scheme has an algebraic space quotient
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a scheme U affine over S and an etale equivalence relation j = (s, t) : R -> U x_S U, the quotient F = U/R is an algebraic space and U -> F is etale and surjective (source lines 1682-1690). The proof is the longest in the chapter: it first shows j separated and locally quasi-finite, then proves representability of the quotient map by producing an fppf covering T_i -> T over which the fibre product T x_F U becomes T_i x_{a_i,U,t} R and descending the resulting separated locally quasi-finite scheme by effectiveness of descent data, then deduces surjectivity and etaleness by fpqc locality, and finally proves representability of the diagonal through a cube whose top face identifies T' x_T G with the base change of j and again applies descent.
